newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania services 11.4 pct down in April.
newsitem.headline: Romania services 11.4 pct down in April.

text.p: Turnover of Romanian services companies dropped by 11.4 percent in April from March in real terms, due mainly to falls in laundry, recreational and hotel services, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.
Hotel and restaurant businesses saw a 7.1 percent fall in April, when recreational services slumped 26.7 percent and laundry services dropped by 22.7 percent.
The CNS said growths had been registered in April in car repairing -- 24.9 percent, repairs of household appliances -- 44 percent and hairdressing and cosmetics services -- 8.6 percent.
Figures refer to commercial services, excluding transport, mail and telecoms.
The private sector took 67 percent of the total January- April turnover of servicing companies, data showed.
